Windows 11 x64 release of X Multi Workspace.

- Manage up to 10 X account workspaces in one window, each with its own persistent session.
- Switch among single, split, and tab layouts; use English or Japanese controls.
- Includes the custom app icon and a change that prevented the first-launch Windows Firewall prompt on the tested PC. Results may vary by PC. WebRTC peer-to-peer features such as Spaces may be limited.
- Both executables are unsigned. Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify your download.

The app uses the official X website for manual sign-in and posting. It does not use the X API or an external server. Existing local X sessions are kept when updating, as long as their app data remains.

日本語: Windows 11 x64向けのインストーラー版・ポータブル版です。最大10枠の独立セッション、分割表示、日本語/英語UIに対応します。初回起動時のファイアウォール確認画面はテストしたPCでは出ませんでしたが、全環境での保証はありません。exeは未署名です。
